name: ci-ledger
description: Explains a GitHub Actions bill, merge queue and pull request flow, including coding agents, and ranks fixes by minutes saved.

interface.shortDescription: Explain your GitHub Actions bill and rank fixes by minutes saved
interface.longDescription: Audits a repository's GitHub Actions runs, jobs, merge queue, pull requests and billing from metadata only, then writes metrics.json, findings.json and a self-contained report.html with fixes ranked by minutes saved.
